title: Pizza Florentina
subtitle: with Eggs and Feta
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep pizza toppings: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line a large oven tray with baking paper. Thinly slice the onion. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Put 1 tsp dried oregano, 2 tbs tomato paste, 2 tbs olive oil and a pinch of sugar in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.

Caramelise onion: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion for 3-4 mins until softened. Add a pinch of sugar and cook for a further 5-6 mins until the onion is golden and caramelised. Stir in the garlic, then season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat, add the spinach and stir until wilted.
Assemble pizzas: Put 2 pita on the lined tray and spread with the tomato mixture. Top with the onion and spinach mixture.

Bake pizzas: Make an indent in the centre of each pizza. Crack 1 egg into a bowl, then carefully pour the egg into the indent. Repeat with 1 egg and the remaining pizza. Crumble over half the feta. Bake the pizzas for 10 mins or until the eggs are set.

Serve up: Meanwhile, put the pepitas in a cold small frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 2-3 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan. Divide the pizzas among plates, crumble over the remaining feta, scatter with the pepitas and enjoy!
Make it again: Keen to make it again? Go super luxe by adding some pan-fried bacon strips, or replace the feta with small dollops of creme fraiche for a more indulgent version.
